user.title: Set up CurbCharge
user.description: Choose whether CurbCharge uses the Home Assistant home location, manual coordinates, or an entity.

data_description.location_source: Use Home Assistant home coordinates, enter coordinates, or select an entity that reports a location.

entity_location.title: Select a location entity
entity_location.description: Choose any entity that currently reports valid latitude and longitude attributes. Only the entity ID is stored.

data_description.location_entity: The entity must currently report valid latitude and longitude coordinates.

reconfigure.title: Change the search location
reconfigure.description: Choose whether to use the Home Assistant home location, manual coordinates, or an entity.

data_description.location_source: Changing the search area may change which nearby stations are included.

reconfigure_entity_location.title: Select a new location entity
reconfigure_entity_location.description: Choose an entity that currently reports valid location coordinates. CurbCharge stores the entity ID, not its coordinates.

data_description.location_entity: If the previous entity is unavailable or has been removed, select a replacement.

reconfigure_manual_location.title: Enter a new search location
reconfigure_manual_location.description: CurbCharge checks the provider before saving this location.

data_description.latitude: Latitude of the center of the charging station search area.
data_description.longitude: Longitude of the center of the charging station search area.

manual_location.title: Enter a search location
manual_location.description: Coordinates are stored only when you choose a manual location.

data_description.latitude: Latitude of the center of the charging station search area.
data_description.longitude: Longitude of the center of the charging station search area.

station_options.title: Choose nearby stations
station_options.description: CurbCharge checks provider connectivity before creating the entry.

data_description.search_radius: Only public charging stations within this distance are included.
data_description.max_stations: Limit the number of stations and their entities.
data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant refreshes charging station data.
data_description.provider: The data provider used to discover stations and availability.

discovery_filters.title: Filter nearby stations
discovery_filters.description: Optionally match NDW stations by their connector groups. Filters apply before the station limit.

data_description.connector_types: Leave empty for any type. A matching connector group with any selected type must also meet the other filters.
data_description.min_power_kw: Optional. A matching connector group must report at least this power.
data_description.require_available: Only include stations when a matching connector group reports available connectors.

belgium_credentials.title: Connect to Eco-Movement Belgium
belgium_credentials.description: Enter the API token issued to you by Eco-Movement. The token is stored in this config entry and redacted from diagnostics.

data_description.api_token: Use only a token you are authorized to use. Do not share it in issue reports.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Eco-Movement credentials
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a replacement API token issued to you by Eco-Movement.

data_description.api_token: The token is stored in this config entry and redacted from diagnostics.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the charging provider.
error.invalid_location: Enter valid coordinates and a supported search area.
error.invalid_entity_location: Select an entity that currently reports valid latitude and longitude coordinates.
error.invalid_api_token: Enter a non-empty printable ASCII API token.
error.invalid_discovery_filters: Enter valid discovery filters. Minimum power must be a finite positive number.
error.invalid_response: The provider returned data in an unexpected format.
error.location_not_configured: Home coordinates are not configured in Home Assistant.
error.rate_limited: The provider is rate limiting requests. Try again later.
error.unsupported_provider: The selected provider is not supported.

abort.already_configured: This provider and search area are already configured.
abort.location_not_configured: The search location is not configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant refreshes charging station data.

data_description.max_stations: Limit the number of stations and their entities.

error.invalid_discovery_filters: Enter valid discovery filters. Minimum power must be a finite positive number.
error.invalid_favourites: One or more selected favourites are no longer available. Refresh the options and try again.
